Name: Grandpa's Toolbelt
Author: ThatBritishMo
Description:
[b][u][size=5]Read the changelog for a full list of improvements[/size]
[/u][/b]
Known Issues:
[list]
[*]If your toolbelt suddenly vanishes, don't panic. Sometimes in a cutscene the game doesn't know when to bring the toolbelt back. Use the Generic Mod Config Menu to re-show the toolbelt again. 
[*]Toolbelt appears during some cutscenes - we're trying to fix this across all cutscenes but it's proving somewhat tricky with the 1.6 API. If you notice a particular cutscene where it's appearing, please comment or raise a bug and we'll try to deal with it.[/*]
[/list][b]
[u][size=3]If you'd like to contribute a translation for this mod, please feel free to either reach out and we'll add it to the files, or you can create your own. See below for language contributors. [/size][/u][/b]

[size=3]NOTE: Requires SMAPI (and for advanced settings: [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b])[/size]

[size=3]Grandpa didn’t only leave you his farm, he left you his most prized possession: his tool belt. Grandpa’s Toolbelt adds six item slots that are permanently fixed above your backpack toolbar. Why only six slots instead of adding another row of inventory space? There’s already a mod for that. We designed this mod to be a supplement, without making things too easy, and the heart-warming inheritance of the toolbelt adds another cozy element to our favorite cozy game. [/size]
[size=3]When you wake up on day 1 (or whatever you add the mod to your grand), you'll find a letter in your mailbox from Robin. Per Grandpa’s wishes, she has been keeping the toolbelt safe until the day you arrived at Pelican Town.[/size]
[size=3]Now you never have to be disappointed that you can’t hoe an artifact spot or run back and forth to the barn because you never remember the milk pail- all because you decided that those tools weren’t worth the space in your backpack.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/42217/42217-1771454340-1687764487.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/42217/42217-1770657164-1673809433.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Instructions[/b][/size]

[size=3]Unzip the contents of the zip file into the Stardew/Mods directory as is.

To use the toolbelt select an item in your inventory and right-click a slot on the toolbelt. The item will be moved there. 
You cannot use an item directly from the toolbelt, instead you will need to place it back in your inventory. 
The toolbelt will accept any item from the inventory so it's easy to swap items in and out. 
To empty a slot on the toolbelt simply click an empty inventory slot and click the toolbelt item you wish to remove.

[size=3]A huge shoutout to our lovely friend, Ams who came up with the idea for the toolbelt. 

The amazing [url=https://ko-fi.com/imnotashrimp83]imnotashrimp83[/url] did the wonderful artwork for the toolbelt as well come up with the storyline and written content for the description and Robin's letter.
